facts.text: The City of Davison separated from Davison Township by incorporating as a city on December 5, 1938, and it is administratively separate from the township.
The completion of the Chicago and Lake Huron Railroad through the area in 1871 marked the beginning of Davison Station, and Davison was incorporated as a village in 1889.
The City of Davison is located on M-15, just north of I-69.
The Davison Downtown Development Authority manages the downtown district and runs events including the Festival of Flags parade, the Pumpkin Festival, a car cruise and Christmas on Main Street.
Christmas on Main, the Davison DDA's free downtown holiday event on the first Friday of December, opens with a Christmas Parade of Lights in which every parade entry must be lighted.
Black Creek flows west through the City of Davison and merges into Kearsley Creek.
Jack N. Abernathy Park in Davison has children's playscapes, a skate park and paved trails, including the 1.6-mile Black Creek Nature Trail that runs along Black Creek.

The annual Trail of Lights at the Robert Williams Nature and Historical Learning Center in Davison Township reached its 10th year in December 2025, with walking nights and tractor wagon rides through trails lit with thousands of lights.
The former Rosemoor Park race track, which hosted the county fair for years, closed in 1943, and its owner developed a subdivision on the track property in 1946.

christmas-light-installation.title: Christmas Light Installation in Davison, MI
christmas-light-installation.meta_description: Christmas light installation for Davison, MI homes. Rooflines, wrapped trees and lit shrubs, with in-season service and takedown included. Free estimate.
christmas-light-installation.h1: Christmas Light Installation in Davison, MI
christmas-light-installation.hero_sub: Warm rooflines, wrapped trees and lit shrubs for Davison homes, with design, installation, in-season service and takedown handled by our crew.
christmas-light-installation.local_paragraph: Davison's homes carry the town's history. It grew from an 1871 railroad stop into a village in 1889 and a city in 1938, and in 1946 the old Rosemoor Park race track, which hosted the county fair for years, became a subdivision. Houses from different decades light differently. An older home may have a steep, simple gable that looks sharpest with one crisp line, while a wider roofline with several peaks needs careful spacing so each section reads clearly. We fit each design to the house, add wrapped trees and lit shrubs where they strengthen the picture and handle installation, in-season service and takedown.
considerations: Match the design to the roofline

A single-story roof with long straight eaves wants even, continuous lines. A two-story home with several peaks needs a layout that shows off the shape without looking cluttered. We plan each run to suit the architecture rather than applying one pattern to every house.

The end of the season matters as much as the start. Our crew handles removal after the holidays, so nobody in your family is on a ladder in January pulling clips off cold gutters. Your estimate lists what is covered from the first install day through removal.

Christmas on Main, the DDA's free downtown event on the first Friday of December, opens with a Parade of Lights. Being lit by that weekend means getting on the schedule early. Installation dates run from roughly October through early December, and early requests get the widest choice.
faq: Is my Davison Township address in your service area?
Yes. Davison Township is covered, and so is the city. The quickest way to start is a quote request with your address, or a call to (248) 756-8915, and we will set up your free estimate.
Do you use colored or warm-white lights?

Either, depending on the look you want. Warm white gives a classic, elegant outline, while color feels playful and nostalgic. Some homes mix the two, with warm white on the roofline and color in the trees. We talk through the options during your free estimate.
Do you light trees and shrubs, or only rooflines?

Both. Rooflines are the backbone of most displays, but tree wraps, canopy lighting and lit shrubs add depth and make the yard feel finished. We recommend what suits your property and include it in your free estimate, so you choose the final scope.

commercial-holiday-lighting.h1: Commercial Holiday Lighting in Davison, MI
commercial-holiday-lighting.hero_sub: Storefront, building and streetscape lighting for Davison businesses, from downtown shops to offices and subdivision entrances.
commercial-holiday-lighting.local_paragraph: Downtown Davison's DDA fills the year with events, and December belongs to Christmas on Main Street. Every entry in the Christmas Parade of Lights that opens it must be lighted, which shows how seriously Davison takes December. When every parade entry glows, a dark storefront stands out for the wrong reason. We light facades, windows and entries, wrap trees on the property, hang bistro strings where they suit the space and add pole or lamppost decor where fixtures allow. Offices, managed properties and subdivision entrances elsewhere in Davison get the same design attention.
considerations: Working with a DDA or merchant group

Downtown districts and municipalities are one of the customer groups we design for. When a DDA or a group of merchants wants a consistent look, we can plan it block by block so the whole street reads as one display rather than a patchwork of separate efforts.

For a property along M-15, the lighting has a practical job: helping drivers pick out your entrance after dark. A lit sign area, an outlined roofline and a clearly marked driveway do that well, and they signal from the road that the business is open for the season.

Downtown displays get bumped, blown and snowed on. A strand that goes dark in mid-December is a call to us, not a job for your staff, because in-season service is built into our work alongside design, installation and takedown. Your estimate details the service that comes with the display.
faq: Is downtown Davison in your commercial service area?

Yes. Storefronts and offices in downtown Davison are within our service area, along with commercial properties across the city and Davison Township. Request a free estimate or call (248) 756-8915 to talk about the building and the look you have in mind.
Can my business be lit in time for Christmas on Main?

It depends on the calendar, so we cannot promise a date before booking. Commercial installs fill the weeks from October into early December, and the earlier you reach out, the more dates remain open ahead of the first Friday of December.
Do you work with HOAs and property managers in Davison?

Yes. Subdivision entrances, common areas and managed properties are all part of our commercial work. Whoever holds the approval, whether a board, a manager or an owner, gets a free estimate that lays out the design and the full scope, from installation to takedown.

permanent-lighting.title: Davison Permanent Lighting | Holiday Light Service
permanent-lighting.meta_description: Permanent roofline lighting in Davison, MI, app-controlled for Christmas, Festival of Flags, the Pumpkin Festival and game days. Get a free estimate.
permanent-lighting.hero_sub: A permanent roofline for Davison homes that switches looks from your phone, ready for every celebration on the town's calendar.
permanent-lighting.local_paragraph: Davison celebrates more than Christmas. The DDA's calendar runs from the Festival of Flags parade to the Pumpkin Festival to Christmas on Main Street, and permanent lighting lets your home keep up with all of it. With the lights mounted along the roofline for good and an app in charge, the house can show red, white and blue for the Festival of Flags, orange for the Pumpkin Festival and Halloween, team colors on game day and a holiday scene in December. Between events, it settles into warm-white accent lighting that makes the house look finished every evening. The layout is planned around your roofline before anything is mounted.
considerations: Festival of Flags, the Pumpkin Festival, Halloween, Christmas on Main and every game night in between call for a different look. With permanent lighting, each change takes a few taps in the app instead of a new install and another afternoon on a ladder.
Suited to every era of home

Davison's homes were built across many decades, and permanent lighting has to suit each style. On a simple gable we keep the run clean and continuous. On a complex roofline we plan around peaks and valleys so it reads clearly at night and quietly by day.

Permanent lighting ends the yearly routine of hanging and removing roofline strands. There is no install date to wait for before the holidays and no takedown in the cold afterward. The roofline is ready whenever you want it, in any season.
faq: Do you install permanent lighting in Davison Township too?

Yes, in the city and throughout Davison Township. Permanent, app-controlled roofline lighting is part of what we offer across Genesee County. Reach us at (248) 756-8915 or through the quote form to arrange a free estimate for your home.
Can I set it up for Festival of Flags or the Pumpkin Festival?

Yes. Choose red, white and blue for the Festival of Flags, orange for the Pumpkin Festival or any colors you like for another occasion, then switch back to warm white when it is over. It all happens in the app, so the change takes moments.
Does it look like Christmas lights all year?

No. Most of the year it can run a soft warm white or stay off entirely, so the house looks like a well-lit home rather than a holiday display. The holiday look appears only when you choose it in the app.
